exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 sampled terminated vendor engineers removed late. Remediated per management response

availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 4 h and RPO 15 min; BIA BP-02 needs RTO 4 h and RPO 15 min: **meets BIA** (P05 finding 5)

reviewer_and_date: Security Systems Manager and Security Manager, 2026-09-10
